WNBA Finals Reach Deciding Seventh Game

The 2026 WNBA Finals have reached a decisive Game 7, with the Atlanta Dream and the Golden State Valkyries competing for their first championship titles at the Chase Center. The matchup features two franchises seeking historic milestones, as the Valkyries reach the finals in only their second season, while the Dream make their fourth finals appearance in pursuit of their inaugural title.

Match Progress and Quarter Highlights

Based on reports from the venue, both teams traded momentum through the opening quarters:

  • First Quarter: The Dream secured an early advantage before the Valkyries responded to edge ahead 12-11.
  • Second Quarter: Atlanta reclaimed the lead following a three-point shot and a driving layup, initiating a scoring run that brought their advantage to 19-14.
  • Third Quarter: The Valkyries rallied with defensive stops and free throws, establishing a brief 4-0 run to shift the game's momentum.
  • Fourth Quarter: The Dream mounted an 11-2 scoring streak, highlighted by a turnaround jump shot from Rhyne Howard to briefly take a 11-10 edge in the frame.

Reported Event Details and Atmosphere

  • Ticketing: Media reports indicated high demand for the matchup, with entry-level seats at the Chase Center reportedly starting at $364, marking high secondary and primary pricing compared to concurrent sporting events.
  • Fan Engagement: Attendees participated in a themed "Ballahalloween" celebration inside the arena, coinciding with the Halloween night scheduling of the final game.

Practical Implications and How to Verify

With the final outcome undetermined as the game progressed, fans can monitor official platforms for verified scores and post-game statistics:

  • Broadcast Channels: The game is scheduled for television coverage via NBC, USA Network, and CNBC in the United States, with streaming available on Peacock. International viewers can check local providers such as Sky Sports in the UK or WNBA League Pass in Australia.
  • Official Verification: Final scores, player statistics, and league announcements can be independently verified through the official WNBA website and Chase Center digital channels.
